question: A can do a work in 15 days, B in 20 days, and C in 30 days. They all start the work together but C leaves after 5 days. How many more days will A and B take to complete the remaining work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 15, 20, 30 = 60 → Total work

Efficiency: A = 4, B = 3, C = 2 → Total = 9/day

Work in 5 days = 9 × 5 = 45 → Remaining = 15

A + B rate = 7/day → Time = 15 ÷ 7 = 2 1/7 days

1/7 day = 24/7 hours = 3 hr 26 min (approx)

**∴ Answer = 2 days, 3 hours, 26 minutes (Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A = 15 days, B = 20 days, C = 30 days, C leaves after 5 days

**Formula used:**

Total Work = LCM of all give
